movelist.name: Quiver Dance
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by +1 Combat Stage each.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Bug Buzz
movelist.range: Cone 2 or Close Blast 2, Sonic, Smite
movelist.effect: Bug Buzz lowers the Special Defense of all targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Toxic
movelist.effect: The target is Badly Poisoned. If the user is Poison Type, Toxic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Whirlwind
movelist.effect: All targets are pushed X meters, where X is 8 minus their weight class. If the Line targets into a Smokescreen, the smoke is dispersed. All hazards in the Whirlwind are destroyed.

movelist.name: Light Screen
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Light Screen may activate it when receiving Special Damage to resist the Damage one step. Light Screen may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: The user ignores the secondary effects that trigger during Accuracy Roll of damaging Moves that target the user. For example, Flamethrower can never inflict the Burn Condition. Defensive.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.effect: The user gains a +3 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack
abilities.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the attacker is Poisoned. On a result of 3 or 4, the attacker is Paralyzed. On a result of 5 or 6, the attacker falls Asleep.
